MikroTik 2.5in SATA 128GB SSD UEFI x86 RouterOS 64bit License (Pre-Install) Level 6

The MikroTik 2.5in SATA 128GB SSD UEFI x86 RouterOS 64bit License (Pre-Install) Level 6 is a high-performance storage solution designed specifically for MikroTik routers and servers. This SSD is equipped with 128GB of storage, providing ample space for network configurations, logs, software, and system updates, ensuring efficient and reliable operation in demanding environments. Built for UEFI boot mode, this SSD is compatible with modern MikroTik machines and offers improved boot times and better compatibility with newer systems. It’s ideal for use with PC MikroTik machines as well as supported MikroTik server machines, offering seamless integration and optimal performance. The SSD comes pre-installed with RouterOS v7.11, MikroTik’s powerful network operating system, which provides comprehensive control over network management, routing, security, and more. Additionally, the device supports OS version updates and downgrades, giving users flexibility to upgrade to newer versions or revert to previous ones depending on their specific requirements. With a MikroTik Level 6 license pre-activated, this SSD unlocks advanced RouterOS features, including sophisticated routing, firewall management, VPN support, and much more. Whether you're building a simple home network or a large-scale enterprise infrastructure, the Level 6 license ensures access to all necessary tools for managing and optimizing your network. Available in multiple storage capacities, including 16GB, 32GB, 64GB, and 128GB, the MikroTik SSD allows you to select the optimal size for your system’s needs. Additionally, it comes with technical support and warranty coverage, ensuring reliable assistance and protection against defects. This SSD is an excellent choice for anyone looking to maximize the performance and reliability of their MikroTik-powered networking devices.

MikroTik 2.5in SATA 128GB SSD Features

  • 2.5in SATA Solid State Drive
  • UEFI Boot
  • Build with PC Mikrotik Machine
  • Supported Server Mikrotik Machine
  • Capacity Available: 16GB / 32GB /64GB/ 128GB
  • OS Version Update and Downgrade Support
  • OS Version v7.11 Pre-Install
  • Technical and Warranty Support
